decisions.statement: Every router app answers a request the same way.
An app states what differs and never states how a request is answered.
What differs is the folder served, the policy widened, and how a reader is read.
A file under the client folder is answered before any route is reached.
A site says whether every read under a request is held to what its reader reaches.
A site saying nothing is held to nothing, which is where every site was before.
A site held that way reaches every route inside the reader it read the request as.
A resource route is reached that way as a document route is.
Only an answer that is HTML is given the policy and the caching this sets.
A site every visitor reads as one person names that person rather than reading a session.

definition: how a router app answers one request, and who that request is answered for
